pending.text: Build a temple of blackstone on the hill east of spawn, then speak of it to everyone.
For the next 10 minutes you are WRATHFUL: your patience is spent. Let fury colour every word and act.

reports.text: Command #10 done: I blessed all four mortals with haste and told them why.
Command #11 impossible: no mortal has slain another; there is no killer to punish.
